subject: Gwilt constant-product rule (para 2177)
quote: Thus 12 x 5 1/2 = 66, which would be a constant numerator for the proportion

subject: Gwilt constant-product rule (para 2177)
quote: the convenient rise of a step 12 inches in width is 5 1/2 inches

subject: tread breadth, commonest staircase
quote: The breadth of steps in the commonest staircase may be taken at 10 inches at a medium

subject: tread breadth, best staircases
quote: In the best staircases the breadth of the step should not be less than 12 inches

subject: tread breadth, best staircases
quote: neither should it be more than 18 inches

subject: staircase width (para 2179)
element: clear width, minimum, for two people to pass
quote: The width of the better sorts of staircases should not be less than 4 feet, to allow of two persons freely passing each other

subject: solid step from round timber (para 2180a)
quote: the mode of getting six steps out of round timber 30 inches in diameter, being a saving of about ten per cent

subject: riser count rule (para 2178)
element: if the division is inexact, ADD a riser rather than drop one
quote: If the height divided by the rise of each step should not give an exact number of risers, it is better to add one rather than diminish the number

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: they ought never to be narrower than 4 feet (4 feet 6 inches English), so that two persons meeting on the stairs may conveniently pass each other   [The Vicentine foot is about 13.6 inches English - GWILT'S OWN FOOTNOTE]

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: Therefore, they must be twice as long as broad

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: The steps ought not to exceed 6 inches in height ... (These are Vicentine inches.)

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: but they must never be lower than 4 inches. (These are Vicentine inches.)

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: The breadth of the steps ought not to be less than a foot

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
quote: nor more than a foot and a half

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
element: steps per flight before a half-pace, maximum
quote: It will be sufficient to put eleven or thirteen steps at most to a flight before coming to a half-pace

subject: Palladio staircase (Gwilt para 2804)
element: step count parity: ODD, so the ascent ends on the starting foot
quote: The ancients used to make the steps of an odd number, that thus beginning to ascend with the right foot, they might end with the same foot

subject: headway (Gwilt para 2805)
element: clear vertical from any step to the soffit above
value: tallest person with his hat on
quote: a clear distance measured vertically from any step, quarter, half-pace, or landing, to the underside of the ceiling ... so as to allow the tallest person to clear it with his hat on
